## What's new

- **Menu sections**: turn on extra sections in the settings and they show up as tabs in the style menu, next to the 29 basic styles. The menu also gets a search box across all sections.
- **12 new sections**: Priority, Status, Work, Colors, Mood, Health, Study, Money, Home, Travel, Seasons (New Year, Carnival, Easter, Festa Junina, Halloween, Christmas and more) and Flags (32 countries).
- **Your own images**: point the **Images folder** setting at a folder in your vault and its images become styles, with one tab per subfolder, for example team crests.

## Improved

- Large sections, like flags and your images, show as a grid. On phones the menu opens from the bottom of the screen.
- Turning a section off only hides it from the menu: tasks that already use its styles keep their look.
